blocks.title: Source code repository
blocks.text: Source code repositories woh platforms hain jahan developers apna code rakhte, sambhalte aur us ki tabdeeliyan track karte hain. Yeh version control dete hain, to kai developers baghair takrao ke ek project par kaam kar sakte hain, aur tamam tabdeeliyon ki tareekh rakhte hain.

items: GitHub: open-source projects ke liye mashhoor platform.
Bitbucket: private aur public dono repositories ke liye.

blocks.prompt: Team project ko source code repository kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Yeh code ka har version is tareekh ke saath rakhti hai ke kis ne kya badla, aur us ka version control kai developers ko ek hi code par ek saath kaam karne deta hai baghair ek doosre ka kaam mitaye.

items: Repositories: version control aur tareekh ke saath code rakhna, sambhalna aur track karna; GitHub, Bitbucket.
